items.title: 6.4 Bond energy (bond dissociation energy) aur enthalpy tabdeeliyan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.4, printed pages 122-123.

blocks.text: Kimiyai reactions mein kimiyai bonds tootte aur bante hain. Jab do atoms ke darmiyan bond banta hai to energy kharij hoti hai, aur utni hi energy jazb hoti hai jab bond toot kar ghair-janibdar atoms de.

blocks.title: Bond dissociation energy
blocks.text: Kisi madde mein ek khas bond ka ek mole torne (dissociate karne) ke liye darkar energy ki ausat miqdar, jise E se zahir karte hain.

Kisi khas madde mein kisi khas bond ki bond energy us ki exact bond energy hai. Ek hi jore ke atoms ke darmiyan bonds ki qeematein mukhtalif compounds mein aam taur par mukhtalif hoti hain, kyunke bond energy par molecule ke doosre atoms asar karte hain: C-C bonds ki qeematein taqreeban 350 se 380 kJ fi mol hain, ethane mein 376, propane mein 356 aur butane mein 352. In mein se har ek exact bond energy hai; mukhtalif molecules ki sab C-C qeematon ka ausat lene se average C-C bond energy milti hai. Amalan exact ke bajaye average bond energies istemal hoti hain.

blocks.caption: Kuch aham bonds ki average bond energies kJ fi mol mein (Table 6.1)

blocks.prompt: Table 6.1 mein C-C bond energy 348 kJ fi mol kyun di gai hai jabke ethane mein yeh 376 hai?
blocks.explanation: 376 ethane ke C-C bond ki exact bond energy hai; doosre molecules 356, 352 aur doosri qeematein dete hain kyunke parosi atoms bond par asar karte hain. Table bohat se compounds ka ausat deta hai, jo hisabat mein aam taur par istemal hota hai.

items: Bond dissociation energy E: kisi bond ka ek mole torne ki ausat energy; exact qeematein compounds mein mukhtalif hain (C-C 376 ethane, 356 propane, 352 butane), to ausat (Table 6.1) istemal hote hain.
